newsitem.title: ITALY: At least 22 dead in plane crash in Italy-firemen.
newsitem.headline: At least 22 dead in plane crash in Italy-firemen.

text.p: At least 22 people on a Russian-built Antonov cargo aircraft were killed on Tuesday when the plane crashed shortly after take off from Turin airport in northwestern Italy, the Italian fire service said.

A spokesman at fire service headquarters in Rome said it was unclear if there were any fatalities on the ground. The aircraft came down near the village of San Francesco al Campo. A local government official there said two buildings were destroyed.
A spokesman at the Di Cirie hospital near Turin told Reuters injured people were being rushed to its casualty centre.
No details of the precise type of Antonov involved, its route or its cargo were immediately available.
Italian television, reporting from the scene, said the plane had come from Moscow.
It crashed shortly after take-off from Turin-Caselle airport.
"At least 22 people are dead. They were all on board," the fire service spokesman said.
